_comment: Reviewed floor for the Rasuwa-Bhotekoshi flood. Deaths currently NDRRMA / MoHA, 16 Bhadra 09:00 (321+216+170+95+65+55+38+27 = 987). Uncontacted 3,916. Injured 279 (168 discharged + 111 still in treatment) / deployed 21,011 / NDRRMA rescued graphic 11,814. The ten-minute cycle reads nirajbhusal.github.io/rasuwa-flood-bulletin and merge_sitrep replaces a group only when its parts add up; a failed scrape leaves these numbers standing. Deaths never go down — Police 794 and a lagging compilation must not put that back over NDRRMA 987. The overview also shows live government figures beside this grid (BIPAD corridor incidents, NDRRMA rescued-persons totals, OPMCM portal counters); those come straight from the portals and are never merged into these numbers. Two rules govern edits. (1) Never sum across groups that the source keeps apart - the `exclusive` flags and `do_not_merge` notes exist because several of these counts overlap, and adding them would invent casualties. (2) Every breakdown must sum to its own stated total; app/domains/flood/merge.py re-adds them at load and the page shows a warning if either stops reconciling. Do not add Tibet (16 dead) onto Nepal's 987.

Kathmandu DEOC 88, National Trauma Centre 48 (33 discharged / 15 still in care on 31 Aug), Rasuwa Hospital Dhunche 74, and police injured-and-rescued 2,301 are labels for other collections — they are not added to the 279.

breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: The public missing-report forms, Hello Sarkar (140), Madhesh Police (30) and the tourist list (668) are separate collections. The same person can appear in more than one. Do not add this breakdown on top of 3,916. Police 25 are already inside the official 3,916.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: सार्वजनिक हराएको फारम, हेलो सरकार (१४०), मधेश प्रहरी (३०) र पर्यटक सूची (६६८) छुट्टै संकलन हुन्। एउटै व्यक्ति एकभन्दा बढी सूचीमा पर्न सक्छ। यो विभाजन ३,९१६ माथि नजोड्नुहोस्। प्रहरी २५ आधिकारिक ३,९१६ भित्र छन्।

breakdowns.caption_en: Security forces, NDRRMA / MoHA 16 Bhadra 09:00. Medical staff, surgical teams and aircraft are counted separately. Earlier 15 Bhadra 18:00 figure was 21,008.
breakdowns.caption_ne: सुरक्षा निकाय, एनडीआरआरएमए / गृह १६ भदौ ०९:००। स्वास्थ्यकर्मी, सर्जिकल टोली र हवाईजहाज छुट्टै गनिन्छन्। अघिल्लो १५ भदौ १८:०० को अंक २१,००८ थियो।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: The 200+ medical staff and 6 surgical teams are not inside the 21,011 security total, and the 14 helicopters are aircraft, not people. NDRRMA also cited 573 helicopter sorties (12 on Tuesday) — flights, not a second headcount.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: २००+ स्वास्थ्यकर्मी र ६ सर्जिकल टोली २१,०११ को सुरक्षा जम्मामा समावेश छैनन्, र १४ हेलिकप्टर हवाईजहाज हुन्, मानिस होइनन्। एनडीआरआरएमाले ५७३ हेलि उडान (मङ्गलबार १२) पनि भनेको छ — उडान, दोस्रो जनसंख्या होइन।

breakdowns.caption_en: SitRep-6 helicopter rescue. NDRRMA's 11,814 rescued (air and ground, 16 Bhadra 09:00) is a separate graphic — not added here. Army air 3,702 (Nepali 3,449 + foreign 253) is another overlapping count. Earlier graphic was 11,379.
breakdowns.caption_ne: सिटरेप-६ हेलि उद्धार। एनडीआरआरएमएको ११,८१४ उद्धार (हवाई र स्थल, १६ भदौ ०९:००) छुट्टै ग्राफिक हो — यहाँ जोडिँदैन। सेना हवाई ३,७०२ (नेपाली ३,४४९ + विदेशी २५३) अर्को ओभरल्यापिङ गणना हो। अघिल्लो ग्राफिक ११,३७९ थियो।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: 14 is the number of helicopters flying, not people rescued. SitRep 1,976, NDRRMA 11,814, army air 3,702, private-sector Kathmandu flights 29, and the army/private heli name-list 654 are not additive.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: १४ भनेको उडानरत हेलिकप्टरको संख्या हो, उद्धार भएका मानिस होइन। सिटरेप १,९७६, एनडीआरआरएमए ११,८१४, सेना हवाई ३,७०२, निजी क्षेत्र काठमाडौं उडान २९ र सेना/निजी हेलि नामावली ६५४ जोडिँदैनन्।

notes.body_en: Kathmandu DEOC still lists 88 injured brought to valley hospitals as a separate collection from the official 279. Kathmandu District Police said on 31 August that 33 of 48 patients at the National Trauma Centre had been discharged and 15 remained in care. Police assistance desks are at Bir Hospital and the Trauma Centre. These hospital counts are not added to the 279.
notes.body_ne: काठमाडौं डीईओसीले उपत्यकाका अस्पतालमा ल्याइएका ८८ घाइतेलाई आधिकारिक २७९ भन्दा छुट्टै संकलनका रूपमा राखेको छ। काठमाडौं जिल्ला प्रहरीले ३१ अगस्टमा राष्ट्रिय ट्रमा सेन्टरका ४८ मध्ये ३३ डिस्चार्ज र १५ उपचाररत रहेको बताएको छ। प्रहरी सहयोग डेस्क वीर अस्पताल र ट्रमा सेन्टरमा छन्। यी अस्पताल गणना २७९ मा जोडिँदैनन्।

notes.body_en: More than 100 homes damaged. Five to seven houses left standing in the bazaar. More than 300 people were waiting for rescue.
notes.body_ne: १०० भन्दा बढी घरमा क्षति। बजारमा ५–७ घर मात्र बाँकी। ३०० भन्दा बढी उद्धारको प्रतीक्षामा थिए।

notes.body_en: 26 staff across 8 banks. Branches were washed away at Timure, Syaphrubesi and Betrawati.
notes.body_ne: ८ बैंकका २६ कर्मचारी। टिमुरे, स्याफ्रुबेंसी र बेत्रावतीमा शाखा बगे।

notes.body_en: About 1,000 inmates are safe. The building at Bidur-3 is damaged.
notes.body_ne: करिब १,००० कैदी सुरक्षित छन्। बिदुर-३ को भवनमा क्षति भएको छ।

name_lists.do_not_merge_en: Eight lists, published separately by different offices. The same person can appear on more than one, so they are never added into a single rescue total. The official injured figure stays 279. NDRRMA's graphic of 11,814 rescued is a separate count from these named lists.
name_lists.do_not_merge_ne: आठ सूची, फरक-फरक कार्यालयले छुट्टै प्रकाशित गरेका। एउटै व्यक्ति एकभन्दा बढी सूचीमा पर्न सक्छ, त्यसैले यी एउटै उद्धार जम्मामा जोडिँदैनन्। आधिकारिक घाइते संख्या २७९ नै रहन्छ। एनडीआरआरएमएको उद्धार ग्राफिक ११,८१४ यी नामावलीभन्दा छुट्टै गणना हो।

missing_found.do_not_merge_en: Public reports, not official figures. Lists stay separate and names are not merged across them. The official uncontacted figure stays 3,916.
missing_found.do_not_merge_ne: सार्वजनिक जानकारी, आधिकारिक तथ्यांक होइन। सूचीहरू छुट्टै रहन्छन् र नाम मिसाइँदैन। आधिकारिक सम्पर्कविहीन संख्या ३,९१६ नै रहन्छ।
